aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab builds practical software for food truck and mobile catering businesses: online orders, collection times, fewer questions. Founded by Dominic Bonini.
aboutPage.meta.title: About us — HatchGrab
aboutPage.story.build: We build practical software specifically for food truck and mobile catering businesses; we help them take online orders, manage collection times, keep orders moving smoothly and spend less time on repetitive questions.
aboutPage.story.change: HatchGrab was created to change that.
aboutPage.story.fixedAddress: Yet most of the software available to them is designed around businesses with a fixed address.
aboutPage.story.focus: Our aim is simple: make running a food truck business easier, with tools designed for how these businesses really work.
aboutPage.story.start: HatchGrab began with a simple observation: food truck businesses need better tools to run themselves.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: After creating Village Foodie, a directory that helps people find food truck businesses coming to their area, I spent more time learning about the challenges mobile food businesses face. Unlike usual restaurants, food truck businesses keep moving, work in different places and serve customers in changing conditions.

comparison.faq.capacityA: Customers only see collection times your kitchen can actually make. The system calculates from each dish’s preparation time and how many you prepare at once.
comparison.faq.capacityQ: How does the system stop my kitchen being overloaded?

comparison.faq.costTrial: {months, plural, one {The first month} other {The first # months}} free, with all features.
comparison.faq.locationsA: Yes. You set up your weekly schedule with places and times; customers order for the place and day you are there.
comparison.faq.locationsQ: Does it work with changing locations?
comparison.faq.paymentsA: Customers can pay online by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay, or pay in person at the food truck. PayPal and Klarna are not supported at present.
comparison.faq.paymentsQ: Which payment methods does HatchGrab support?
comparison.faq.termA: No. There is no minimum contract term and no notice period. You can cancel at any time; the fee is charged monthly in advance, and access continues until the end of the month you paid for.
comparison.faq.termQ: Is there a minimum contract term?

comparison.faq.tseA: HatchGrab is not a POS system and it has no TSE. How to record online orders in your POS system is a question to ask your tax adviser.
comparison.faq.tseQ: Do I still need a POS system with a TSE?
comparison.faq.whatA: An ordering system takes orders online before customers come to the food truck: they choose dishes and a collection time and pay online or on collection; the order appears in your kitchen. A POS system or card machine takes payment at the food truck. The two complement each other.

featuresPage.detail.accountant_reports: Sales, tax and refunds for any month, quarter or tax year — ready to download for your accountant.
featuresPage.detail.advance_preordering: Let customers order for an upcoming date or time, before the event.
featuresPage.detail.auto_accept: Online orders are accepted automatically — no need to confirm each one.
featuresPage.detail.branded_qr_code: Add your logo to your QR code.
featuresPage.detail.buzzer_tracking: When you hand out a buzzer, give the order its number; you know which buzzer belongs to which order.
featuresPage.detail.customer_display: A screen where customers can see order numbers and when they are ready.
featuresPage.detail.discovery_map_listin: Your food truck business appears on the public HatchGrab map, so nearby customers can find you.
featuresPage.detail.documents_reminders: Save your certificates such as food hygiene, insurance and gas safety in one place. We remind you before anything expires; you can send them to an event or market organiser in one tap.
featuresPage.detail.embed_schedule: Show your upcoming dates on your own website. Each one links straight to its ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.event_types: Create your own event types with custom prices and settings for events and festivals.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The most complete way to use HatchGrab: a live kitchen screen (KDS); it is also the only way to keep taking orders when the signal drops.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_capacity: Set how much your kitchen can cook at once and how long it takes. Once a time slot is full, customers cannot choose it.
featuresPage.detail.loyalty_stamp_cards: Reward repeat customers through digital stamp cards — stamps are collected and redeemed automatically.
featuresPage.detail.meal_deals_upsells: Bundle items into meal deals, offer upsells on the checkout page, and raise the average order value.
featuresPage.detail.messenger_instagram_: Like WhatsApp auto-replies, for Messenger and Instagram enquiries too.
featuresPage.detail.multi_device_kitchen: Run several screens — at the front counter and in the kitchen — all showing the same live orders.
featuresPage.detail.multi_user_access: Give staff their own separate logins with the right level of access.
featuresPage.detail.offline_protection: If the signal drops, online orders pause, so customers cannot place orders you can’t see. The iPhone, iPad, Android app helps you take orders offline too; the web dashboard needs an internet connection.
featuresPage.detail.online_payments: Take card payment upfront via Stripe when customers order online.
featuresPage.detail.preorder_deadline: Set a deadline for items that need advance notice.
featuresPage.detail.private_events: Add private events that are not shown on the map, with their own private ordering link and QR code.
featuresPage.detail.profit_per_event: Add what each dish costs you and see what you actually earned at every event, not only your takings.
featuresPage.detail.qr_code: A printable QR code that opens your menu and ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.schedule_import: We fill in your schedule automatically from your website, or from a photo you already post on Facebook. You just check and confirm.
featuresPage.detail.sms_order_alerts: Send customers an SMS automatically when their order is ready.
featuresPage.detail.social_media_posts: Upload your designs — we automatically add your dates, places and times for every week and event.
featuresPage.detail.sold_out_toggle: Mark any item sold out in one tap — it shows greyed out to customers straight away.
featuresPage.detail.stock_countdown: Set a stock count; it goes down as orders come in, then sells out automatically.
featuresPage.detail.tap_to_pay: Take card payments on a supported mobile phone; no separate card machine needed.
featuresPage.detail.ticket_printing: Print order tickets on a Bluetooth or wired printer in the kitchen.
featuresPage.detail.time_slot_selection: Customers choose a collection time slot, so demand spreads across your whole service.
featuresPage.detail.walkup_orders: Take and manage walk-up orders at the truck; payment on your own card machine.
featuresPage.detail.web_dashboard: Run your service from the browser of any mobile phone, tablet or laptop.
featuresPage.detail.whatsapp_auto_replie: Reply automatically to WhatsApp enquiries about your menu and schedule.

landing.does.capacityBody: Set how much you can cook at once and how long it takes. Once a collection time is full, customers cannot choose it.
landing.does.devicesBody: The mobile phone in your apron, the tablet on the counter, the laptop in the vehicle — it also runs on the card machine you already take payment on.
landing.does.lede: Most ordering systems assume a fixed address, reliable wifi and the same hours every week. You, though, are in a new place every week, at different times, in places with patchy or no mobile signal at all. HatchGrab was built for exactly that.
landing.does.offlineBody: If the signal drops, online orders pause automatically, so customers cannot place orders you can’t see. Keep taking orders with the iPhone, iPad, Android app.
landing.does.postsBody: Upload the design you already post on Facebook or Instagram. We will fill in your dates, places and times — ready to share every week or every day.
